# HexPiece 2.9.7

The Light fruit, second pass after the Egghead GIFs. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks and tests pass, and
I rendered and checked every new pose and effect.

- **No more M1s.** Left click does nothing with the Light fruit: the five kicks, the sprinting kick, the fall from the air and the
  sword's left-click cuts and right-click guard are all gone.
- **C, Ama no Murakumo, is now a lunge (new move).** The sword of light forms in your hand and you fly at them with it thrust out ahead,
  laid out flat like Kizaru in the GIF, with a trail of light behind you. You go through whoever you're looking at and a few blocks
  past them, cutting everyone the blade passes. Where you land: one wide cut, a wave of light, and the sword is gone. 4-second
  cooldown. In first person you see the sword in your own hand while you fly, then the cut.
- **X, Yasakani no Magatama, as at Egghead.** You rise into the air with both arms thrust out at the ground ahead, a star of light on
  each open palm, and long oval slugs of light pour out and burst where they land (each burst now flashes a star). You can fly around
  over them while it pours (it switches flying on) instead of being held in place.
- **B, the clones, fly now.** Every light clone flies at its target through the air in an arc, laid out with its sword thrust ahead
  and afterimages behind, then cuts and bursts, like the clone swarm at Egghead.
- **Flying looks like Egghead.** Hovering and flying hold the arms out from the sides, legs together. I also found that since 2.9.0
  the flying pose leaned backwards instead of into the flight; it leans forward now.
- Z (become light), V (speed-of-light kick) and right click (finger laser and charged beam) are unchanged from 2.9.6.
